Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins

Battle of Grand Port.fact: The first attack on Île de la Passe was launched on the evening of 10 August, with Staunch towing boats carrying over 400 soldiers, Royal Marines, and volunteer sailors to the islet under cover of darkness, guided by Nereide's pilot.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Launching his own boats at _____:00 pm, guided by the pilot and commanded by Pym's second-in-command, Lieutenant Norman, Pym's marines and sailors landed on the island in darkness under heavy fire fro
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Launching his own boats at 8:00 pm, guided by the pilot and commanded by Pym's second-in-command, Lieutenant Norman, Pym's marines and sailors landed on the island in darkness under heavy fire from the defenders. Seven British personnel were killed and 18 wounded in the battle, in which the storming party managed to seize intact French naval code books and took 80 prisoners.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: The brief expedition cost the _____ two men wounded and one missing, to French casualties of at least ten killed or wounded
Battle of Grand Port.fact: The brief expedition cost the British two men wounded and one missing, to French casualties of at least ten killed or wounded.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: These ships were Guy-_____é's squadron of Bellone, Minerve, the corvette Victor, and prizes Windham and Ceylon returning from the Comoros Islands
Battle of Grand Port.fact: These ships were Guy-Victor Duperré's squadron of Bellone, Minerve, the corvette Victor, and prizes Windham and Ceylon returning from the Comoros Islands.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Duperré was unaware of the _____ occupation of the island, and Willoughby intended to lure the French squadron into the channel by concealing the British presence off the harbour
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Duperré was unaware of the British occupation of the island, and Willoughby intended to lure the French squadron into the channel by concealing the British presence off the harbour. Once there, Willoughby hoped to defeat them or damage them so severely that they would be unable to break out unaided, thus isolating Duperré's squadron from Hamelin's force in Port Napoleon and containing the French in separate harbours to prevent them from concentrating against the British blockade squadrons.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Willoughby brought _____ close to Île de la Passe to combine their fire and protect his boats, which were carrying 160 men back to Nereide from a raid near Grand Port that morning
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Willoughby brought Nereide close to Île de la Passe to combine their fire and protect his boats, which were carrying 160 men back to Nereide from a raid near Grand Port that morning. Raising a French tricolour over Île de la Passe and on Nereide, Willoughby transmitted the French code captured on the island: "L'ennemi croise au Coin de Mire" and received an acknowledgement from Duperré.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: The use of these signals convinced Duperré, over the objections of _____ on Minerve, that Néréide was Surcouf's privateer Charles, which was expected from France
Battle of Grand Port.fact: The use of these signals convinced Duperré, over the objections of Captain Pierre Bouvet on Minerve, that Néréide was Surcouf's privateer Charles, which was expected from France.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: The French squadron closed with the harbour during the morning, _____ entering the channel under Île de la Passe at 1:40 pm
Battle of Grand Port.fact: The French squadron closed with the harbour during the morning, Victor entering the channel under Île de la Passe at 1:40 pm. As Victor passed Néréide and the fort, Willoughby opened fire, Lieutenant Nicolas Morice surrendering the outnumbered corvette after the first volley.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Willoughby sent boats to attempt to take possession of _____, but they were unable to reach the vessel
Battle of Grand Port.fact: The French squadron closed with the harbour during the morning, Victor entering the channel under Île de la Passe at 1:40 pm. Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: As Victor passed Néréide and the fort, Willoughby opened fire, _____ surrendering the outnumbered corvette after the first volley
Battle of Grand Port.fact: As Victor passed Néréide and the fort, Willoughby opened fire, Lieutenant Nicolas Morice surrendering the outnumbered corvette after the first volley.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Behind the corvette, _____ and Ceylon pushed into the channel and signalled Morice to follow them, exchanging fire with the fort
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Behind the corvette, Minerve and Ceylon pushed into the channel and signalled Morice to follow them, exchanging fire with the fort. As Morice raised his colours again and followed Minerve, a large explosion blasted out of Île de la Passe, where the false French flag had ignited on a brazier as it was lowered and set fire to a nearby stack of cartridges, which exploded in the close confines of the fort.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Three men were killed and 12 badly burned, six cannon were dismounted and one discharged unexpectedly, killing a _____ sailor in a boat attempting to board Victor
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Three men were killed and 12 badly burned, six cannon were dismounted and one discharged unexpectedly, killing a British sailor in a boat attempting to board Victor.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: With the fort out of action and a significant number of her crew scattered in small boats in the channel, Néréide was alone and unable to block _____ entry to Grand Port
Battle of Grand Port.fact: As Morice raised his colours again and followed Minerve, a large explosion blasted out of Île de la Passe, where the false French flag had ignited on a brazier as it was lowered and set fire to a nearby stack of cartridges, which exploded in the close confines of the fort. With the fort out of action and a significant number of her crew scattered in small boats in the channel, Néréide was alone and unable to block French entry to Grand Port.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Although several boats were in danger of being run down by the French ships and one even bumped alongside _____, all eventually rejoined Néréide safely
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Although several boats were in danger of being run down by the French ships and one even bumped alongside Minerve, all eventually rejoined Néréide safely. French losses were more severe: Minerve suffered 23 casualties and Ceylon eight.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: French losses were more severe: _____ suffered 23 casualties and Ceylon eight
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Although several boats were in danger of being run down by the French ships and one even bumped alongside Minerve, all eventually rejoined Néréide safely. French losses were more severe: Minerve suffered 23 casualties and Ceylon eight.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: The opportunity to cause significant damage to the French in the narrow channel had been lost, with _____ joining the squadron in passing through the channel with minimal resistance
Battle of Grand Port.fact: The opportunity to cause significant damage to the French in the narrow channel had been lost, with Bellone joining the squadron in passing through the channel with minimal resistance.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: In addition to _____ losses in the explosion at the fort, two men had been killed and one wounded on Néréide
Battle of Grand Port.fact: In addition to British losses in the explosion at the fort, two men had been killed and one wounded on Néréide.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Command of Victor passed to _____
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Command of Victor passed to Henri Moisson.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: In the afternoon, _____ used mortars on Île de la Passe to shell the French squadron, forcing Duperré to retreat into the shallow harbour at Grand Port
Battle of Grand Port.fact: With both sides recognising that further action was inevitable, Willoughby sent a boat to Sirius requesting additional assistance and Duperré sent a message overland with Lieutenant Morice, requesting support from Hamelin's squadron (Morice fell from his horse during the mission and was severely injured). In the afternoon, Willoughby used mortars on Île de la Passe to shell the French squadron, forcing Duperré to retreat into the shallow harbour at Grand Port.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: One French ship had failed to enter the channel off Grand Port: the captured _____
Battle of Grand Port.fact: One French ship had failed to enter the channel off Grand Port: the captured East Indiaman Windham.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Early on 21 _____, her French commander attempted to shelter in Rivière Noire
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Willoughby subsequently sent officers into Grand Port on 21 August under a flag of truce, demanding the release of Victor, which he insisted had surrendered and should thus be handed over to the blockade squadron as a prize. Early on 21 August, her French commander attempted to shelter in Rivière Noire.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Sirius and Néréide met on the morning of 22 August, _____ welcoming Pym with signals describing an "enemy of inferior force"
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Sirius and Néréide met on the morning of 22 August, Willoughby welcoming Pym with signals describing an "enemy of inferior force". Although Duperré's squadron was technically weaker than the four British frigates combined, Willoughby's signal was misleading, as the French had taken up a strong crescent-shaped battleline in the bay and could cover the mouth of the channel through which the British ships could only pass one at a time.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Duperré also anticipated the arrival of reinforcements from _____ under Governor Charles Decaen at any time and could call on the support of soldiers and gun batteries on shore
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Duperré also anticipated the arrival of reinforcements from Port Napoleon under Governor Charles Decaen at any time and could call on the support of soldiers and gun batteries on shore.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: In addition, _____ launches had moved the buoys marking the channel through the coral reef to confuse any British advance
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Although Duperré's squadron was technically weaker than the four British frigates combined, Willoughby's signal was misleading, as the French had taken up a strong crescent-shaped battleline in the bay and could cover the mouth of the channel through which the British ships could only pass one at a time. Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: He was followed by Néréide, but _____ had refused to allow Pym to embark the harbour pilot, the only person in the British squadron who knew the passage through the reefs
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Although Duperré's squadron was technically weaker than the four British frigates combined, Willoughby's signal was misleading, as the French had taken up a strong crescent-shaped battleline in the bay and could cover the mouth of the channel through which the British ships could only pass one at a time. He was followed by Néréide, but Willoughby had refused to allow Pym to embark the harbour pilot, the only person in the British squadron who knew the passage through the reefs.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Without guidance by an experienced pilot, _____ was aground within minutes and could not be brought off until 8:30 am on 23 August
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Without guidance by an experienced pilot, Sirius was aground within minutes and could not be brought off until 8:30 am on 23 August. Although the squadron was now guided by Néréide's pilot, Sirius again grounded at 3:00 pm and Magicienne 15 minutes later after over-correcting to avoid the reef that Sirius had struck.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: At 10:00 am, _____ and Magicienne arrived and at 2:40 pm, after a conference between the captains as to the best course of action, the force again attempted to negotiate the channel
Battle of Grand Port.fact: At 10:00 am, Iphigenia and Magicienne arrived and at 2:40 pm, after a conference between the captains as to the best course of action, the force again attempted to negotiate the channel. Néréide and Iphigenia continued the attack, Iphigenia engaging Minerve and Ceylon at close range and Néréide attacking Bellone.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Néréide and _____ continued the attack, Iphigenia engaging Minerve and Ceylon at close range and Néréide attacking Bellone
Battle of Grand Port.fact: At 10:00 am, Iphigenia and Magicienne arrived and at 2:40 pm, after a conference between the captains as to the best course of action, the force again attempted to negotiate the channel. Néréide and Iphigenia continued the attack, Iphigenia engaging Minerve and Ceylon at close range and Néréide attacking Bellone.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Although the squadron was now guided by Néréide's pilot, Sirius again grounded at 3:00 pm and _____ 15 minutes later after over-correcting to avoid the reef that Sirius had struck
Battle of Grand Port.fact: At 10:00 am, Iphigenia and Magicienne arrived and at 2:40 pm, after a conference between the captains as to the best course of action, the force again attempted to negotiate the channel. Although the squadron was now guided by Néréide's pilot, Sirius again grounded at 3:00 pm and Magicienne 15 minutes later after over-correcting to avoid the reef that Sirius had struck.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Long-range fire from _____ was also directed at Victor, which was firing on Néréide
Battle of Grand Port.fact: At 10:00 am, Iphigenia and Magicienne arrived and at 2:40 pm, after a conference between the captains as to the best course of action, the force again attempted to negotiate the channel. Although the squadron was now guided by Néréide's pilot, Sirius again grounded at 3:00 pm and Magicienne 15 minutes later after over-correcting to avoid the reef that Sirius had struck.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Within minutes of the _____ attack, Ceylon surrendered and boats from Magicienne sought but failed to take possession of her
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Within minutes of the British attack, Ceylon surrendered and boats from Magicienne sought but failed to take possession of her. The British frigate swung around, presenting her stern to Bellone and pulling both her broadsides away from the French squadron.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: The British frigate swung around, presenting her stern to _____ and pulling both her broadsides away from the French squadron
Battle of Grand Port.fact: The French crew drove the captured East Indiaman on shore, joined shortly afterwards by Minerve, Bellone, and later by Victor, so that by 6:30 pm the entire French force was grounded and all but Bellone prevented from firing their main broadsides by beached ships blocking their arc of fire. Bellone was ideally positioned to maintain her fire on Néréide from her beached position, and at 7:00 pm a cannon shot cut Néréide's stern anchor cable.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Raked by _____ and desperate to return fire, Willoughby had the bow anchor cable cut, bringing a portion of his ship's starboard broadside to bear on Bellone
Battle of Grand Port.fact: The French crew drove the captured East Indiaman on shore, joined shortly afterwards by Minerve, Bellone, and later by Victor, so that by 6:30 pm the entire French force was grounded and all but Bellone prevented from firing their main broadsides by beached ships blocking their arc of fire. Bellone was ideally positioned to maintain her fire on Néréide from her beached position, and at 7:00 pm a cannon shot cut Néréide's stern anchor cable.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Building an improvised bridge between the _____ ships and the shore, Bouvet increased the men and ammunition reaching Bellone and thus significantly increased her rate of fire
Battle of Grand Port.fact: The British frigate swung around, presenting her stern to Bellone and pulling both her broadsides away from the French squadron. At 8:00 pm, Duperré was seriously wounded in the cheek by shrapnel from grapeshot fired by Néréide; Ensign Vigoureux concealed his unconscious body under a signal flag and discreetly brought him below decks while Bouvet assumed command of the French squadron on board Bellone, placing Lieutenant Albin Roussin in charge of Minerve.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Recognising her battered state, _____ then diverted fire from Néréide to concentrate on Magicienne
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Building an improvised bridge between the French ships and the shore, Bouvet increased the men and ammunition reaching Bellone and thus significantly increased her rate of fire. Recognising her battered state, Bouvet then diverted fire from Néréide to concentrate on Magicienne.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Refusing to surrender until all options had been exhausted, _____ dispatched boats to Sirius, asking Pym if he believed it would be practical to send boats to tow Néréide out of range
Battle of Grand Port.fact: By 10:00 pm Néréide was a wreck, receiving shot from several sides, with most of her guns dismounted and casualties mounting to over 200: the first lieutenant was dying, the second was severely wounded, and Willoughby's left eye had been dislodged from its socket by a wooden splinter. Refusing to surrender until all options had been exhausted, Willoughby dispatched boats to Sirius, asking Pym if he believed it would be practical to send boats to tow Néréide out of range.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Pym replied that with the boats engaged in attempting to tow Sirius and _____ off the reef it was not possible to deploy them under fire to tow Néréide
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Recognising her battered state, Bouvet then diverted fire from Néréide to concentrate on Magicienne. Pym replied that with the boats engaged in attempting to tow Sirius and Magicienne off the reef it was not possible to deploy them under fire to tow Néréide.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Pym also suggested that _____ disembark his men and set fire to his ship in the hope that the flames would spread to the French ships clustered on shore
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Refusing to surrender until all options had been exhausted, Willoughby dispatched boats to Sirius, asking Pym if he believed it would be practical to send boats to tow Néréide out of range. Pym also suggested that Willoughby disembark his men and set fire to his ship in the hope that the flames would spread to the French ships clustered on shore.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: At 11:00 pm, _____ ordered a boat to row to Bellone and notify the French commander that he had surrendered
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Pym also suggested that Willoughby disembark his men and set fire to his ship in the hope that the flames would spread to the French ships clustered on shore. Willoughby refused this suggestion as it was not practical to disembark the dozens of wounded men aboard Néréide in the growing darkness and refused to personally abandon his men when Pym ordered him to transfer to Sirius.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: The message was instead conveyed by _____ prisoners from Néréide who had dived overboard and reached the shore during the night
Battle of Grand Port.fact: At 11:00 pm, Willoughby ordered a boat to row to Bellone and notify the French commander that he had surrendered. The message was instead conveyed by French prisoners from Néréide who had dived overboard and reached the shore during the night.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Recalling the false flags used on 20 _____, Bouvet resolved to wait until morning before accepting the surrender
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Recalling the false flags used on 20 August, Bouvet resolved to wait until morning before accepting the surrender.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Magicienne, like _____, had been stranded out of range of the beached French ships and so had instead directed her fire against a battery erected on shore, which she had destroyed by 2:00 am
Battle of Grand Port.fact: During the remaining hours of darkness, Pym continued his efforts to dislodge Sirius from the reef and sent orders to Lambert, whose Iphigenia had been blocked from firing on the French by Néréide and also prevented from pursuing the Minerve by a large reef blocking access to the beach. With Iphigenia now becalmed in the coastal waters, Pym instructed Lambert to begin warping his ship out of the harbour, using anchors attached to the capstan to drag the ship slowly through the shallow water.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: This flag prompted a fresh burst of cannon fire from Bouvet, and it was not until _____ ordered the mizzenmast to be chopped down that the French acknowledged the surrender and ceased firing
Battle of Grand Port.fact: This flag prompted a fresh burst of cannon fire from Bouvet, and it was not until Willoughby ordered the mizzenmast to be chopped down that the French acknowledged the surrender and ceased firing.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Pym refused permission, insisting that _____ instead assist him in pulling Sirius off the reef
Battle of Grand Port.fact: At 7:00 am, Lambert notified Pym that he had cleared the reef separating Iphigenia from the French ships and suggested that if Pym sent reinforcements from Sirius he might be able to board and capture the entire French squadron. Pym refused permission, insisting that Lambert instead assist him in pulling Sirius off the reef.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Although _____ intended to subsequently attack the French alone, Pym forbade him and sent a direct order for Lambert to move out of range of the enemy
Battle of Grand Port.fact: At 7:00 am, Lambert notified Pym that he had cleared the reef separating Iphigenia from the French ships and suggested that if Pym sent reinforcements from Sirius he might be able to board and capture the entire French squadron. Pym refused permission, insisting that Lambert instead assist him in pulling Sirius off the reef.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: At 10:00 am, _____ reached Sirius and together the ships began firing at French troops ashore, who were endeavouring to raise a gun battery within range of the frigates
Battle of Grand Port.fact: At 7:00 am, Lambert notified Pym that he had cleared the reef separating Iphigenia from the French ships and suggested that if Pym sent reinforcements from Sirius he might be able to board and capture the entire French squadron. At 10:00 am, Iphigenia reached Sirius and together the ships began firing at French troops ashore, who were endeavouring to raise a gun battery within range of the frigates.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: At 7:30 pm, _____ was set on fire, her magazines exploding at 11:00 pm
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Magicienne, irretrievably stuck on the reef, rapidly flooding, and with her capstan smashed by French shot, now bore the brunt of long-range French fire from both Bellone and the shore until Pym ordered Curtis to abandon his ship, transferring his men aboard Iphigenia. At 7:30 pm, Magicienne was set on fire, her magazines exploding at 11:00 pm.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: On the shoreline, _____é had been unable to spare any men to take possession of Néréide until 3:00 pm
Battle of Grand Port.fact: On the shoreline, Duperré had been unable to spare any men to take possession of Néréide until 3:00 pm.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: At 4:00 am on 25 _____, the newly erected French gun battery opened fire on Sirius and Iphigenia, which returned fire as best they could
Battle of Grand Port.fact: At 4:00 am on 25 August, the newly erected French gun battery opened fire on Sirius and Iphigenia, which returned fire as best they could.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: French boats attempted to reach _____ and capture her before she exploded, although they turned back when Pym launched his own boats to contest possession of the wreck
Battle of Grand Port.fact: At 4:00 am on 25 August, the newly erected French gun battery opened fire on Sirius and Iphigenia, which returned fire as best they could. Accepting that Sirius was beyond repair, Pym removed all her personnel and military supplies, setting fire to the frigate at 9:00 am, shortly after Iphigenia had pulled beyond the range of the battery, using a cannon as an anchor after losing hers the previous day.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: During the morning, _____é sent an official boarding party aboard Néréide, who wet the decks to prevent any risk of fire from the ships burning in the harbour and removed 75 corpses from the frigate
Battle of Grand Port.fact: During the morning, Duperré sent an official boarding party aboard Néréide, who wet the decks to prevent any risk of fire from the ships burning in the harbour and removed 75 corpses from the frigate.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Hamelin departed _____ at midnight on 21 August, intending to sail northeast and then south, down the island's eastern shore
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Hamelin departed Port Napoleon at midnight on 21 August, intending to sail northeast and then south, down the island's eastern shore.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: The two extra days _____ had spent rounding Isle de France saw activity from the British forces remaining at Grand Port
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Hamelin departed Port Napoleon at midnight on 21 August, intending to sail northeast and then south, down the island's eastern shore. On 23 August, Hamelin's squadron spotted and captured a British transport ship named Ranger, sent 24 days earlier from the Cape of Good Hope with 300 tons of food supplies and extensive naval stores for Rowley on Isle Bourbon.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: There had been no strong winds in the bay and _____ was forced to resort to slowly warping towards the mouth of the channel in the hope of escaping the approaching French reinforcements
Battle of Grand Port.fact: There had been no strong winds in the bay and Iphigenia was forced to resort to slowly warping towards the mouth of the channel in the hope of escaping the approaching French reinforcements.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: On the morning of 27 August, _____ discovered the brig Entreprenant off the harbour mouth and three French sail approaching in the distance
Battle of Grand Port.fact: On the morning of 27 August, Lambert discovered the brig Entreprenant off the harbour mouth and three French sail approaching in the distance. Recognising that resistance under such conditions against an overwhelming force was futile, Lambert negotiated with Hamelin, offering to surrender Île de la Passe if Iphigenia and the men on the island were given permission to sail to Isle Bourbon unmolested.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: The message also threatened that if _____ refused, the French would attack and overwhelm the badly outnumbered British force
Battle of Grand Port.fact: On the morning of 27 August, Lambert discovered the brig Entreprenant off the harbour mouth and three French sail approaching in the distance. Recognising that resistance under such conditions against an overwhelming force was futile, Lambert negotiated with Hamelin, offering to surrender Île de la Passe if Iphigenia and the men on the island were given permission to sail to Isle Bourbon unmolested.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Iphigenia was still _____ (3⁄4 mi) from Île de Passe at the edge of the lagoon and was low on shot and unable to manoeuvre in the calm weather without anchors
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Iphigenia was still 1.2 kilometres (3⁄4 mi) from Île de Passe at the edge of the lagoon and was low on shot and unable to manoeuvre in the calm weather without anchors.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Recognising that food supplies were low, reinforcements had not arrived and that his ammunition stores were almost empty, _____ agreed to the terms
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Recognising that resistance under such conditions against an overwhelming force was futile, Lambert negotiated with Hamelin, offering to surrender Île de la Passe if Iphigenia and the men on the island were given permission to sail to Isle Bourbon unmolested. The message also threatened that if Lambert refused, the French would attack and overwhelm the badly outnumbered British force.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Lambert later received a message from _____ proposing similar terms and notified the French governor that he had surrendered to Hamelin
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Lambert later received a message from Decaen proposing similar terms and notified the French governor that he had surrendered to Hamelin. Decaen was furious that Hamelin had agreed terms without consulting him, but eventually agreed to accept the terms of the surrender as well.

Battle of Grand Port.subject: Indian Handicrafts & Coins
Battle of Grand Port.question: Decaen was furious that _____ had agreed terms without consulting him, but eventually agreed to accept the terms of the surrender as well
Battle of Grand Port.fact: Lambert later received a message from Decaen proposing similar terms and notified the French governor that he had surrendered to Hamelin. Decaen was furious that Hamelin had agreed terms without consulting him, but eventually agreed to accept the terms of the surrender as well.
